engineering.details: Existing continuity, hydraulic radius, Froude, specific-energy and Manning-capacity model remains authoritative; renderer consumes those outputs.

pedagogy.details: Four-step sequence ties section geometry to continuity, regime classification, and Manning capacity without claiming solved normal depth.

functionality.details: Source review covers host-scene construction, validated parameter rebuild, deterministic host-time tracers, reset/snapshot/resize and disposal.

animation.details: Tracer motion is purposeful, deterministic, reduced-motion compatible at host level, and explicitly presentation-scaled.

spatial3d.details: Real Three.js U-channel, water volume, staff, contextual geometry and camera presets are implemented; rendered comparison was unavailable.

accessibility.details: Keyboard buttons, step text, metrics and reduced-motion-aware camera behavior are present; browser/AT check pending.

visual.details: Surveying-style layered HUD, restrained chrome, responsive composition and focus mode are implemented in source; no rendered pass is claimed.

reuse.details: Runtime v1 host scene/time ownership retained with exact Three.js peer version and owned resource disposal.

unresolvedBlockers: Independent WebGL render and surveying-reference visual comparison remain required before readiness/public approval.
